name: Minervino Murge (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Minervino Murge (Minerva with an owl on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Minervino Murge, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Minervino Murge arms — Minerva with an owl on white, crowned, within branches
